name: Delinquency Shock (+1 Month)
description: Simulates an immediate 1-month deterioration in delinquency status.
assumptions: PROJECT_DEFINED. Assumes no intervention from servicer.

name: Full Cure to Current
description: Simulates a delinquent loan instantly curing to CURRENT status.
assumptions: PROJECT_DEFINED. Retains historical 6m DPD max, only resetting current streak.

name: FICO Deterioration (-50 Points)
description: Simulates a 50 point drop in origination FICO.
assumptions: PROJECT_DEFINED. Used as proxy for unobserved borrower credit deterioration.

name: Equity Erosion (+10% LTV)
description: Simulates a 10 percentage point increase in original LTV, proxying a property value drop.
assumptions: PROJECT_DEFINED. Does not dynamically recompute current LTV if current UPB amortized.
